name: comp-440
title: Icon Tooltip Tabs
description: A small dark tab bar holding only a house, a panels glyph and a cube; hovering pops up the tab's name, and a 3 badge rides the middle icon.
use: Saving space in a cramped toolbar where the three icons are already familiar to users.
avoid: When icons are ambiguous: no name appears until hover, so touch users never see one.
a11y: The icons are aria-hidden and the triggers carry no aria-label, so screen readers announce unnamed tabs. (keyboard: yes, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A compact dark rounded bar on black holds three icon-only tabs: a house, a window-panels glyph and a cube. The selected tab is hugged by a lighter rounded block, and a white tooltip bubble floats above with a small name.
behaves: Hovering an icon lifts a white label bubble above the bar; clicking selects that icon and swaps the single line of content below. The middle icon keeps a small 3 badge.
customise: Icon choice, tooltip names, the 3 badge and content lines are written inside; changing them means editing the triggers. Sizing and spacing are classes.
weight: light: Three icons, small tooltips and a badge; only light opacity and panel transitions.
